newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian interior minister blasts security tsar.
newsitem.headline: Russian interior minister blasts security tsar.

text.p: Here are some key statements made by Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov at a news conference on Thursday in which he accused security chief Alexander Lebed of plotting to seize power in Russia by force:
"He (Lebed) said he would become president before the end of the incumbent's tenure. It is clear that this can be achieved only by unconstitutional means, by means of a mutiny.
"The obstacle to such a development until recently was the Interior Ministry, which yesterday was joined by the Defence Ministry...
"We have intelligence information that (Lebed) was promised that 1,500 (Chechen) gunmen would help him to power here in Moscow...
"(Lebed) has decided to move ahead using force instead of waiting for the next presidential poll...
"The question is what awaits Russia if Lebed comes to power through a creeping coup...
"He (Lebed) is actively using his authority as Security Council secretary to create power structures reporting personally to him."
Lebed's response, carried by Interfax news agency, was terse:
"There can be no talk of a mutiny," he said. Asked to explain Kulikov's charges, Lebed added: "The poor thing has got everything wrong."
